# Study Overview {-}

The **SONA Exercise & Eating Study** (*Exercise Motivations and Eating Behaviors*; UT Austin investigator: Katherine Schaumberg, PhD) is an online survey study of exercise and eating motivations and behaviors, run through the UT Austin SONA research participation system. Participants complete a single REDCap survey session (about 1.5–2 hours) and receive 2 SONA course credits for completing the survey in full.

The survey covers demographics, medical and treatment history, alcohol and drug use, height and weight; exercise habits and motivations; thoughts and feelings related to exercise, body image, weight gain, self-esteem, mood, mental health, and self-worth; how exercise may affect relationships with others; and hypothetical scenarios asking whether participants would keep exercising under different conditions (e.g., when sick or injured). No directly identifiable information (e.g., name, date of birth) is collected.

This codebook documents every variable in the study's REDCap project (PID 796), organized by measure. It follows the structure of the [EMBARK Lab Meta Codebook](https://github.com/embark-lab/Meta-Codebook) so SONA measures can be compared with the lab's other projects.

Use the sidebar to navigate:

- **Procedures** — survey flow, consent, participant ID, and data-quality checks.
- **Measures at a Glance** — every instrument in survey order with item counts and scored variables.
- **All Measures** — every variable, organized by measure, with descriptions, value coding, and scoring.
- **Data Requests and Terms of Use** — how to request SONA data.

The full machine-readable data dictionary is in [`Codebook/sona_codebook.xlsx`](https://github.com/embark-lab/SONA-Codebook/blob/main/Codebook/sona_codebook.xlsx) (also `.csv`), generated from the REDCap codebook export in `Redcap_Raw_Codebook/Sona-codebook.pdf`.
